{
  "rule": "If the facts describe the defendant soliciting money from multiple members of the public by promising returns, knowing there is no ability to repay and without any legal approval or licensing, the conduct should be classified solely as ‘非法吸收公众存款’; do not add ‘诈骗’ unless the deception concerns the existence or nature of the investment itself.",
  "keywords": [
    "明知没有偿还能力",
    "承诺支付月利息",
    "骗得...共计",
    "非法吸收公众存款",
    "无合法资质",
    "向公众募集资金"
  ]
}
message.reasoning_content: We need to produce a correction rule to prevent the AI from incorrectly assigning multiple crimes (like "诈骗;非法吸收公众存款") when only one applies. The error: AI gave both "诈骗" and "非法吸收公众存款". The correct is only "非法吸收公众存款". So rule: When the conduct matches the statutory definition of illegal public fund raising (i.e., raising funds from the public without approval, promising returns, etc.) and does not meet the elements of fraud (e.g., no deception about existence of funds?), we should only charge illegal public fund raising, not fraud. So rule: If the case involves solicitation of funds from multiple investors with promised returns, and the defendant knows they cannot repay, and the activity is a public offering without a license, classify as illegal public fund raising, not fraud. Keywords: "明知没有偿还能力", "以...为名义", "承诺支付月利息", "骗得...共计", "非法吸收公众存款". Also "公众" "募集" "无合法资质". Provide JSON.
